entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The school trip is finally coming to[n]a close...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I never thought I would have the chance[n]to go on one this year as well...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It barely even felt like I was outta the[n]country though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even Yusuke showed up.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm simply glad the storm didn't make[n]its way over here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It may not have been the most exciting[n]trip, but we still had a good time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Honestly though, I'm thankful we didn't[n]have to deal with the storm. They truly[n]are dreadful...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, what'd you end up doin' yesterday?[n]You keepin' secrets from me? That's[n]against the bro code!
I'm not telling.
Went to the beach.
I was with someone.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What!? That sounds pretty damn[n]suspicious to me...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm not gonna keep pryin' though.[n]Last thing I need is your secret lover[n]comin' after me with an axe.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What, by yourself? No way I'm gonna[n]believe that!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The desperation in your face is quite[n]unbecoming, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, for real!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Actually, don't say anything. Last thing[n]I need is your secret lover comin' after[n]me with an axe.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's enough, you guys.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's almost time for us to leave.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It felt like this trip went by in a flash.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not sure if I want to go home or[n]stay here longer at this point...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm ready to head home and get back[n]to work!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. It would be best for us to gather[n]clues on that case sooner rather than[n]later, correct?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah! People're totally waitin' for us to[n]take action!
